required_corrections: DISCLOSE DIVERGENT TAILS (transparency, sharpest hostile rebuttal): the two du'as are identical ONLY through '...wa an a'mala salihan tardah' (ترضاه). After that they diverge — Sulayman adds 'wa adkhilni bi-rahmatika fi ibadika s-salihin' (admit me among Your righteous servants, 27:19), the forty-year-old adds 'wa aslih li fi dhurriyyati... inni tubtu ilayka wa inni min al-muslimin' (set right my offspring; I have repented, 46:15). The thesis quote correctly stops at 'that pleases You', but the article must state the tails explicitly and turn shared-core/station-specific-tail into the feature — never imply the FULL prayers are word-for-word identical.

FIX VOICE-4 'subject' wording: the angle line 'The only time a human is the subject, it is a prayer' is grammatically inverted — in the passive يوزعون the humans/troops ARE the grammatical subject, and in اوزعني God is the subject while the human is the object (-ni). Reword to the accurate insight: the human is NEVER the AGENT/doer of وزع — always marshaled by an unnamed force (passive) or asking God to do the marshaling (the prayer). Also tighten 'one verb' to 'one root': form-I passive يوزعون and form-IV active اوزعني are different measures of the shared root, not the same verb.

COMPLETE THE OVERLAP NOTE: overlap_note names two Sulayman pieces (sovereign-who-refused-to-be-paid, dhul-qarnayn-and-sulayman) but omits the directly relevant PUBLISHED '/posts/sulayman-ants-hearing-quran — Sulayman and the Ants', which covers the 27:18-19 ant scene where this prayer sits. The core thesis (46:15 twin + وزع census) is genuinely novel and NOT in that article, but the 27:19 scene description overlaps — cross-link and differentiate rather than claim 'none'.

ANCHOR awzi'ni GLOSS (already flagged in proposal risks — keep it mandatory): ground the 'rank me into gratitude' reading in classical mufassirun (al-Tabari / Ibn Kathir gloss اوزعني as الهمني / dispose-me / make-me-cling). Form-IV اوزعني carries 'dispose / make cling to'; the 'marshal into ranks' sense belongs to form-I يوزعون. Present the payoff as a shared-ROOT resonance, not identical meaning across measures.

MINOR — 'peak of his command over jinn/wind/animal-speech' (PHRASE-3): wind is not in Surah 27's immediate scene (established at 21:81 / 34:12 / 38:36). Fine as overall characterization of Sulayman's dominion; do not imply the wind appears in this passage.
